evidence.fact: Miro's AI OKR Assistant creates tailored OKRs for a department after the user adds company context and sets deadlines.
Zensai Perform & Engage 365 offers a 'Suggest OKRs' AI feature that drafts goals at the team or department level.

Kollabe's OKR generator takes a department, a mission and a timeframe, then produces objectives with measurable key results and suggested initiatives. These tools draft goals, but a manager still decides on and commits to them.

AI takeoff tools from vendors such as ConstructConnect and Trimble use computer vision to detect, count and measure items on digital drawings. Vendors say this can cut takeoff time by up to 80%. Turning those quantities into a priced bid still depends on the firm's own cost data, assemblies and scope judgment.

Vendors claim AI takeoff is 80–98% accurate on clean commercial drawing sets. Accuracy is weaker on scanned sheets and dense MEP sets. Scope interpretation, pricing judgment and risk allocation are still done by people.
No license is required to work as a cost estimator. Certifications from ASPE, AACE and ICEAA are voluntary.
